title: Where I have shipped real things.

bullets: Build and maintain React-based web pages for UIC Medicine's Otolaryngology department, covering faculty profiles, residency programs, patient appointments, seminars, and department events.
Design layouts in Figma before implementation and use specification-based prompting with GitHub Copilot to generate component code.
Review and test all AI-generated output before shipping to production.
Handle broken data states, API failures, and malformed CMS content to ensure a reliable user experience.
Maintain WCAG accessibility compliance and cross-browser reliability under healthcare compliance requirements.

Scope an MCP-based workflow to sync department website content directly from hospital scheduling systems, faculty directory systems, event management systems, and residency program databases, reducing manual content updates for department staff.
Rebuilt the full website as the sole developer using React and Tailwind CSS.
Designed all layouts in Figma, then used AI-assisted workflows with GitHub Copilot to generate and review code from component specifications.
Reviewed all AI-generated output before merging, ensuring full understanding of every change shipped.
Integrated Stripe Checkout for online donations, handling session state, webhook confirmation, and payment failure edge cases.
Connected Google Analytics to UX decisions, improving SEO and conversion outcomes.
Set up CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and Netlify as the sole developer.

items.role: Cloud Analyst · Frontend Developer · Oracle Cloud
bullets: Built frontend components for two Oracle Fusion Cloud products: BHE Services (operations management) and BHE-HCM (HR and workforce management) for Berkshire Hathaway Energy.
Developed using Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), a low-code platform built on HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. Became the primary VBS resource across both teams, entirely self-taught.
Built Redwood-style UI components following Oracle's enterprise design system for consistency and accessibility across dashboards.
Connected components to Oracle Fusion HCM backend APIs via REST, handling payroll data, staffing records, and workforce management data.
Built reusable UI modules that reduced development time and improved data rendering speed across both products.
Found and resolved over 100 pre-release bugs at the API-UI boundary, significantly reducing post-release issues.
Supported both teams simultaneously without missing a deadline.
Received Oracle's Employee Recognition Award for cross-team contribution.
Built REST APIs for a restaurant reservation portal using Node.js and Express
Connected frontend to backend routes with end-to-end input validation
Redesigned and implemented the homepage using Figma
